name: Unity Save Migration and Recovery Verification
requiredSequence: On a clean extraction, run node Tools/verify_v1_17_step02.mjs --baseline <exact-v1.17-step01-project> and retain the JSON report
Open a separate working copy of the exact Step 2 candidate in Unity 6000.5.9f1 and retain compilation output with zero errors
Run Legends of Rus/Validate Commercial Vertical Slice and retain the result
Run Legends of Rus/Tests/Run v1.17 Step 2 Self-Tests and retain the result
Run every EditMode and PlayMode test and retain both NUnit XML files with zero failed, skipped, or inconclusive tests

On disposable profiles, verify first launch, unversioned and legacy v1-v5 import, strict complete raw-v6 import, envelope-v1 payload-v6 preservation, normal relaunch, backup recovery, unrecoverable corruption, canonical future raw/envelope barriers, and explicit reset
Verify PrimaryDurablyCommitted reset adoption after primary flush with injected backup and staging-cleanup failures, retaining CanPersist=false and LastWriteResult
Confirm all 12 inherited isolation fixtures preserve primary, backup, and staging and that every other inherited test remains byte-identical to Step 1
Retain raw primary, backup, and staging values before destructive cases and prove blocked cases do not automatically persist a fallback default
Verify offline, suspend/resume, and forced termination around each staged write phase on representative Android hardware without invoking the blocked Android build workflow
exitCriteria: PlayerSaveData remains payload version 6 and all 32 existing fields survive a current-v6 round trip
Envelope version 1 detects payload, length, encoding, structure, and envelope corruption deterministically
Literal legacy v1 through v5 payloads migrate to version 6 without mutating the source before a successful commit
Unversioned raw payloads retain the v1 migration path, while raw current-v6 imports require all 32 typed fields with no duplicate known field
Canonical differently shaped or oversized future envelopes and canonical future raw payloads block downgrade
A durably flushed reset primary may be adopted after a later redundancy or cleanup failure without reporting full journal success
A valid primary wins, a missing primary never resurrects backup-only history, staging is never promoted, and eligible invalid-primary backup recovery preserves player progress
Unsupported future data and unrecoverable corruption retain raw evidence and block normal persistence
Explicit reset cannot recover pre-reset progress after later primary corruption
All 12 relevant inherited fixtures isolate the complete three-key namespace without PlayerPrefs.DeleteAll and every other inherited test remains identical
Legacy GameState mutator booleans are not durable proof; copy-on-write mutation transactions remain required before closed/player-facing testing or a transactional-durability claim
No cloud/account recovery, provider activation, runtime economy authority, commercial activation, or production Android authority is introduced
hardStop: This checkpoint validates only the local save/recovery foundation. ResolvedPackageLockApproved remains false, so Android preflight and APK build remain blocked. Passing Step 2 does not authorize production providers, economy/commercial activation, cloud recovery, signing, or publishing.
nextDevelopmentMilestone: v1.17 Step 3 — Crash and Error Reporting Foundation
